ask: cuont how many ppl are coming incl plus ones plz
sentence: Shows a live headcount for an event where each person answers going, maybe or no and sets how many guests they bring, and totals only those going plus their guests.
use_when: Counting how many people are coming to a party or gathering, including plus ones
Everyone in the chat needs to say going, maybe or no for an event
Guests need to add how many extra people they are bringing
Checking who has not replied yet
dont_use_when: Choosing between several options or dates, which needs a poll
Splitting costs or tracking who owes money
Assigning who brings which item or task
